item.title: Winter Sports Athlete of the Season Nominees Down to 17!
item.description: We started with 35 nominees for our initial list of Winter Sports Athlete of the Season. It was not easy trying to get a list down to 35, there are so many deserving athletes in our local area. And each of those athletes is beyond deserving of this award. Sadly, we can only have two winners, one boy and one girl.So we have let a random generator pick our list of the 17 nominees who will be moving on. item.title: MnDOT announces 2026 road construction projects
item.description: MnDOT announced its 2026 road construction projects on Tuesday, including multiple that will impact motorists in east-central Minnesota.The projects include: • Striping and pavement marking along I-35 in Pine County, which is expected to wrap up by May. • Resurfacing and updating over 10 miles of Highway 65, starting between Stanchfield and Cambridge after the Fourth of July. item.title: Winter storm warning to take effect in Pine County
item.description: A winter storm warning will take effect in Pine County starting at 4 p.m. on Friday until 1 a.m. Sunday, according to the National Weather Service.According to the alert, heavy mixed precipitation is expected, with total snow and sleet accumulations between 1 and 3 inches.Ice is also anticipated to accumulate between one-tenth and one-quarter of an inch.
